_source: Single source for the ten supervision-agreement terms shown on /terms#agreement. Wording is draft, pending counsel review. Text inside {{double braces}} is an example value (rates, cadence, notice periods are placeholders, not Lily policy) and is rendered with an Example marker.

terms.title: Parties
terms.text: Graduate (Supervisee) and Licensed Supervisor, each identified by verified Lily profile

terms.title: Rate
terms.text: {{$95}} per 50-minute individual session; {{$45}} per person for groups of up to six

terms.title: Cadence
terms.text: Weekly, {{Thu 7:00pm}}, adjustable by mutual written notice

terms.title: Format
terms.text: Video or in person; {{1 of every 4}} sessions may be group

terms.title: Hours goal
terms.text: {{3,000}} supervised hours toward licensure, about {{24 months}}

terms.title: Cancellation
terms.text: {{24 hours}} notice; later cancellations are billable at {{50%}}

terms.title: Payment
terms.text: Supervisee pays supervisor directly after each session, within {{7 days}}

terms.title: Electronic signatures
terms.text: Both parties agree typed or tapped signatures in Lily are binding

terms.title: Modifications
terms.text: Changes take effect only when both parties accept them in the app

terms.title: Termination
terms.text: Either party may end with {{14 days}} notice; logged hours remain valid
